thread:
lena_sales: Quick heads-up 1: NovaTrust wants to kick off a POC but dropped several enterprise asks in the RFP: one-time SCIM bulk import (500k users), near-real-time delta (they asked for 15s), customer-supplied HSM for signing tokens (FIPS 140-2) and strict session lifetime requirements (<=8h), plus SAML audience DN checks. Need feasibility + rough ETA + pricing impact. cc @chuang_se @owen_security @rajinfra

chuang_se: short answer: doable but requires work. Bulk import of 500k users we can run as a one-off job (import worker + backfill window). 15s delta polling is aggressive; architecture supports delta tokens but that frequency will increase sustained RPS and KV cache churn.

owen_security: compliance: customer-supplied HSM (bring-your-own-HSM) is supported in Private deployments. For Hosted we can use CMK with Cloud KMS (AWS/GCP/Azure) with key policies, but not direct HSM key import unless we do an HSM gateway. Also they require FIPS 140-2 attestation on signing keys 10. Hosted + CMK meets most reqs but not direct HSM import.

rajinfra: infra notes: timeline estimates
- SCIM bulk import tooling + dry-run: 1 week (engineering + runbook)
- 15s poll testing & capacity tuning: 2 weeks (load tests + rate limit config)
- Hosted CMK hook (assuming customer provides service account/credentials): 1-2 weeks to validate
- Private BYOHSM path: 4-8 weeks (networking, HSM validation, ops playbook)

lena_sales: pricing flags: need to propose two paths: Hosted + CMK (fastest) vs Private BYOHSM (higher TCV). They also want a 3-month pilot discount and an SLA for delta latency.

chuang_se: mitigations for 15s poll: 1) recommend enabling compact delta queries (only ids + updated timestamps) 2) use patch + transactional batching on our side to reduce DB writes 3) implement per-tenant token bucket with backoff and circuit-breaker to avoid noisy-neighbor impact. If they cannot send events, consider an intermediate poller in their VPC to push deltas to us (pull-to-push) which reduces cross-tenant load.

owen_security: SAML details: we can validate subject DN and certificate fields. Need exact assertion examples. Also confirm accepted clock skew (they asked for <=5s) 1 small but possible if both sides NTP-sync. We'll add this to the security questionnaire.

lena_sales: sample config snippet they can fill in for POC:
```
scim.bulk_import = true
scim.bulk_batch_size = 2000
scim.poll_interval = 15s
scim.delta_mode = compact
scim.base_url = https://scim.novatrust.example/v2
import.auth = delegated-admin

kms.provider = AZURE
kms.cmk_resource = /subscriptions/0000/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/vault/keys/keyname
kms.hsm_required = true

saml.max_session = 8h
saml.clock_skew_seconds = 5
```

rajinfra: created infra ticket INF-2042 for bulk-import runbook + poll-scaling test. qa-bot: POC-2024 created.

lena_sales: next steps: 1) ask NovaTrust for sample SAML assertions + acceptance test vectors, 2) ask for expected delta ops/min and sample user record size to price Hosted add-on vs Dedicated, 3) confirm whether they can provide a staging HSM or whether Private is required. I'll loop back with answers by EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
